method: Independent direct linguistic and exact-base controls review. Retained explicit width/height quotient labels; clarified active sizing and independent-dimension wording. Model-reviewed, not native-certified.

rows.context_and_review_note: Retained Keep the relationship (width / height) as a transparent ratio label. The explicit quotient prevents assaɣ being read merely as an unspecified relationship. hḍu means preserve here: its object is the ratio and the UI is a checkbox, not Save or a document-lock action. DimensionControls.kt:19 supplies this label; :66–69 copies the same percentage or derives the other pixel dimension from original.width/original.height. Integer rounding still applies, so the label does not promise impossible exact rational equality at all pixel sizes. Unchecking allows independent dimensions.

Retained identical ratio wording for the separate selection checkbox. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:762–763 sets paintCanvas.lockSelectionAspect; PaintCanvas.kt:635 passes it to geometry.resized for dragged selection handles. It preserves proportional placement geometry, not file persistence and not a prohibition on all edits. This is a different setting from DimensionControls despite the shared wording. The fixed 48dp selection row is a possible layout risk for the explicit parenthetical; no rendered test was performed.

rows.context_and_review_note: Revised the first sentence to active AN Paint changes the image size, avoiding the uncertain feminine passive construction. Replaced buḥdut nn-s with s ixf nn-s (each by itself) for a clear independent-dimension instruction. The remove-checkmark instruction remains and quotes ui_lock_aspect_ratio EXACTLY. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:1014 initializes DimensionControls locked=stretch; :1016 shows this help for image scaling, while the alternative canvas-size help is separate. :1024 calls document.resize with stretch. No file save, crop, automatic unlocking or guarantee against distortion is implied.
